Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
precursor preparation

Charge formamidine acetate, OA and ODE

Mix 0.1042 g formamidine acetate salt (HN=CHNH2·CH3COOH) with 0.8 mL OA and 3.2 mL ODE. This is the complete prepared FA-oleate formulation, distinct from the 0.51 mL injection aliquot. A final stock volume or molarity is not reported.
